mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EVENT ( CALENDAR_ID, OWNER_USERNAME, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, LOCATION, START_DATE, END_DATE, START_TIME, END_TIME, IS_ALL_DAY, IS_LUNAR, LUNAR_MONTH, LUNAR_DAY, LUNAR_LEAP_MONTH, IS_RECURRING, RECURRENCE_TYPE, RECURRENCE_INTERVAL, RECURRENCE_END_DATE, RECURRENCE_COUNT, RECURRENCE_DAYS, PARENT_EVENT_ID, GROUP_ID, STATUS, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{calendarId}, #{ownerUsername}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isAllDay}, #{isLunar}, #{lunarMonth}, #{lunarDay}, #{lunarLeapMonth}, #{isRecurring}, #{recurrenceType}, #{recurrenceInterval}, #{recurrenceEndDate}, #{recurrenceCount}, #{recurrenceDays}, #{parentEventId}, #{groupId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EVENT SET CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId}, TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, LOCATION = #{location}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, IS_ALL_DAY = #{isAllDay}, IS_LUNAR = #{isLunar}, LUNAR_MONTH = #{lunarMonth}, LUNAR_DAY = #{lunarDay}, LUNAR_LEAP_MONTH = #{lunarLeapMonth}, IS_RECURRING = #{isRecurring}, RECURRENCE_TYPE = #{recurrenceType}, RECURRENCE_INTERVAL = #{recurrenceInterval}, RECURRENCE_END_DATE = #{recurrenceEndDate}, RECURRENCE_COUNT = #{recurrenceCount}, RECURRENCE_DAYS = #{recurrenceDays}, GROUP_ID = #{groupId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
UPDATE TB_EVENT SET OWNER_USERNAME = #{newOwnerUsername}, CALENDAR_ID = #{newCalendarId}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'

UPDATE TB_EVENT SET EXCEPTION_DATES = CASE WHEN EXCEPTION_DATES IS NULL THEN CONCAT('["', #{exceptionDate}, '"]') ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(EXCEPTION_DATES, 1, LENGTH(EXCEPTION_DATES) - 1), ',"', #{exceptionDate}, '"]') END, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME, c.COLOR as CALENDAR_COLOR, g.GROUP_NAME as GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR as GROUP_COLOR FROM TB_EVENT e INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON e.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON e.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID WHERE e.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED'

SELECT DISTINCT e.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME, c.COLOR as CALENDAR_COLOR, g.GROUP_NAME as GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR as GROUP_COLOR, CASE WHEN e.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END as IS_SHARED, COALESCE(es.SHARED_BY, cs.SHARED_BY) as SHARED_BY_USERNAME, COALESCE(esu.NAME, csu.NAME) as SHARED_BY_NAME, COALESCE(es.SHARE_TYPE, cs.SHARE_TYPE) as SHARE_TYPE, CASE WHEN e.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN 'OWNER' WHEN es.SHARE_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN es.SHARE_TYPE WHEN cs.SHARE_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN cs.SHARE_TYPE WHEN ug.USER_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'EDIT' ELSE NULL END as ACCESS_TYPE, CASE WHEN e.OWNER_USERNAME != #{username} AND e.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL AND ug.USER_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as IS_GROUP_SHARED FROM TB_EVENT e INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON e.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON e.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EVENT_SHARE es ON e.EVENT_ID = es.EVENT_ID AND es.USERNAME = #{username} AND es.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER esu ON es.SHARED_BY = esu.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER csu ON cs.SHARED_BY = csu.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER_GROUP ug ON e.GROUP_ID = ug.GROUP_ID AND ug.USERNAME = #{username} AND ug.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE e.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED' AND ( e.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR es.EVENT_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL OR cs.CALENDAR_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL OR (e.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL AND ug.USER_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL) )

SELECT e.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME, c.COLOR as CALENDAR_COLOR, g.GROUP_NAME as GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR as GROUP_COLOR FROM TB_EVENT e INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON e.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON e.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID WHERE e.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY e.START_DATE, e.START_TIME

SELECT e.*, u.NAME as OWNER_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME, c.COLOR as CALENDAR_COLOR, g.GROUP_NAME as GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR as GROUP_COLOR FROM TB_EVENT e INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON e.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON e.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID WHERE e.PARENT_EVENT_ID = #{parentEventId} AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY e.START_DATE

SELECT CASE WHEN e.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} THEN 'OWNER' WHEN es.SHARE_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN es.SHARE_TYPE WHEN cs.SHARE_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN cs.SHARE_TYPE WHEN ug.USER_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'EDIT' ELSE NULL END FROM TB_EVENT e INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON e.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EVENT_SHARE es ON e.EVENT_ID = es.EVENT_ID AND es.USERNAME = #{username} AND es.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs ON c.CALENDAR_ID = cs.CALENDAR_ID AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER_GROUP ug ON e.GROUP_ID = ug.GROUP_ID AND ug.USERNAME = #{username} AND ug.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE e.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND e.STATUS != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT WHERE CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
